22.04 is a sensible default. Make sure the cache key includes the npm-lock hash.

24.04 LTS is the better target. Less drift from production.
Moved to ubuntu-latest yesterday — pinning to 24.04 was causing churn whenever GitHub bumped the patch. ubuntu-latest is the most reliable label now.
ubuntu-latest is fine since GHA versions the underlying image carefully.
